name: Gemini Fullstack LangGraph Quickstart
description: Full-stack research agent that generates search queries with Gemini, reflects on gaps and returns an answer with citations.
whatItDoes: Users ask a question in a web chat and the agent performs iterative web research before replying with sourced conclusions. It is a reference for developers building research-augmented chat apps.
howItWorks: A LangGraph graph on a FastAPI backend generates queries, calls Google Search through the Gemini API, reflects on whether more searching is needed and loops up to a limit before synthesising. A Vite/React frontend streams progress; a CLI example and Docker Compose setup are included.

requirements.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
